TriCyclic Antidepressants (TCAs)
•	 amitriptyline (Elavil)
Drug may cause  appetite (especially for carbo-
hydrates/sweets) and weight gain. High fiber 
may  drug absorption.
Monitor caloric intake. Maintain consistent amount of fiber in diet.
Noradrenergic/Specific Serotonic Antidepressants (NaSSA)
•	 mirtazapine (Remeron)
Some herbal and natural products may  toxicity. 
Drug can also be used as an appetite stimulant 
and may cause significant  in appetite/weight 
gain.
Avoid tryptophan and SJW.
Additive effects may produce adverse effects or serotonin  
syndrome.
